generic_lessons: An exact native unit definition index must be joined to GameInfo, the production row, the birth event and stable full ID; do not reuse a remembered index from another unit.
A valid JSON candidate can misuse Lua pcall by treating its status boolean as a tuple. Execute an isolated failure-shaped fixture before native use.
In Lua a local helper declared after a function is not automatically in that earlier lexical scope. A compiling patch can still call an unintended nil global.
A synthetic regression needs real objects, consumer-compatible topology and behavior assertions. A long setup plus a list of test names is not a runnable regression.
A native move qualifier may allow a destination occupied by a friendly civilian. Preserve explicit civilian stack guards and diagnose routing separately from native legality.
A candidate calling private functions is not a read-only public API probe just because it issues no move. Reconstruct the relevant checks through supplied qualified public ports.
An available neighbor and geometric adjacency to a native path suffix are clues, not proof of every future detour edge or successful founding.
When visibility blocks a lookup, emit unknown or skipped; do not subsequently emit an absence result for the unqueried object.
